text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to amend the existing parking regulations in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St Mark's Road between Jane Street and Humbercrest Boulevard, to be in effect between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The proposed parking amendments are the result of consultation with the local Councillor.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Amended the parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the south side of St Mark's Road from a point 103 metres west of Jane Street to Jane Street and from a point 30 metres east of Humbercrest Boulevard to a point 73 metres east thereof, to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. Amended the stopping prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of St Mark's Road, from a point 103 metres east of Humbercrest Boulevard to a point 103 metres west of Jane Street, to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday.
